product_family: AuthoredUp - LinkedIn content creation and analytics platform with Chrome extension, dashboard, editor, drafts, calendar, and advanced analytics. No AI content generation; focuses on content scheduling, formatting, and performance measurement.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Vendor help page identifies the certified entity as 'TalentKit doo' at 'Veljka Dugosevica 54, 11050 Belgrade, Serbia' and states: 'Our efforts in securing our software, maintenance, and support services have been recognized with an ISO 27001 certification.' The page displays a certificate image but publishes no certificate registration number or certifying body for independent verification.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Vendor help page states: 'Yes, AuthoredUp complies with GDPR and other data protection laws.' It lists that AuthoredUp 'Enables you to delete your account and all personal data at any moment', 'Communicates what data is collected and how', 'Does not sell your data', and 'Does not use your personal data for ad monetization.'

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable - LinkedIn content creation tool, no healthcare or protected health information handling

privacy.ai_training_note: No mention of training on user data. Platform does not use generative AI for content creation; focuses on scheduling and analytics only.
privacy.data_region: Germany (EU) - data hosted with European-owned cloud infrastructure

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Assumed standard HTTPS for GDPR compliance; not explicitly detailed

security.name: Data Retention
security.value: Duration of relationship plus 2 years after service termination

security.name: Cookie Policy
security.value: Uses strictly necessary, performance, functionality, analytics, and social networking cookies. Users can decline non-essential cookies.

security.name: User Data Control
security.value: Users retain all rights and control to their content. AuthoredUp receives limited license only for service operation and security.

products.name: AuthoredUp Platform (Web App)
products.data_scope: LinkedIn profile data, post performance metrics, follower analytics, draft storage
products.notes: All-in-one dashboard with content scheduling, formatting, analytics, and historical post collection

products.name: AuthoredUp Chrome Extension
products.data_scope: Same as platform; extension adds in-browser formatting and publishing
products.notes: Native formatting, preview, and scheduling directly on LinkedIn interface

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with paid tiers (specific pricing on https://authoredup.com/pricing)

flags: Over-claim: Homepage states 'we do not collect your cookies' but privacy policy and cookie policy clearly document use of performance, analytics, functionality, and social networking cookies. This is misleading.
ISO 27001 certification claimed but no certificate number or IAF registry link provided for independent verification.
No SOC 2 certification; typical for growth-stage SaaS but notable for security-conscious procurement.
DPA not available as standalone document; data processing terms embedded in general Terms and Conditions.
Company structure complexity: TalentKit Limited (UK) is legal entity but processing partner TalentKit doo (Serbia) holds ISO 27001 certification.
